<issue>
InlineShape.height returns width instead of height

#### Description

When accessing the `height` property of an `InlineShape` object, it returns the width value instead of the actual height.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Create a document and add an image
doc = Document()
paragraph = doc.paragraphs[0]

# Add an inline shape (image) with specific dimensions
run = paragraph.runs[0] if paragraph.runs else paragraph.add_run()
inline_shape = run.add_picture('image.png', width=Inches(2), height=Inches(3))

# Check dimensions
print(f"Width: {inline_shape.width}")
print(f"Height: {inline_shape.height}")

# Expected: Width and Height should be different values
# Actual: Both return the same value (width)
```

The height property incorrectly returns the width dimension, making it impossible to get the actual height of inline shapes.
</issue>
